title: Embedding coordinates into a product index
statement: For natural numbers $w$ and $s$ and an index $i \in \{0,\ldots,s-1\}$, the map sending $o \in \{0,\ldots,w-1\}$ to the pair $(i,o)$, identified with its index in $\{0,\ldots,sw-1\}$, is an injective map from $\{0,\ldots,w-1\}$ to $\{0,\ldots,sw-1\}$.
